question: For ports that are DOWN, show the port ID, tenant ID, and MAC address with the running sum of the port’s standard attribute ID within each security group, and also include (for the same MAC address) the administratively-up port name, port security status, and the row number ordered by MAC address using a window frame of 2 preceding rows and 1 following row. Do not return any rounded answers.

prediction.sql:
WITH down_ports AS (
    SELECT 
        p.id AS port_id,
        p.tenant_id AS tenant_id,
        p.mac_address AS mac_address,
        SUM(p.standard_attr_id) OVER (PARTITION BY sgpb.security_group_id ORDER BY p.standard_attr_id) AS running_sum_std_attr
    FROM ports p
    JOIN securitygroupportbindings sgpb ON p.id = sgpb.port_id
    WHERE p.status = 'DOWN'
),
admin_up_ports AS (
    SELECT 
        p.mac_address AS mac_address,
        p.name AS port_name,
        psb.port_security_enabled AS port_security_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY p.mac_address ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num
    FROM ports p
    JOIN portsecuritybindings psb ON p.id = psb.port_id
    WHERE p.admin_state_up = 1
)
SELECT 
    d.port_id,
    d.tenant_id,
    d.mac_address,
    d.running_sum_std_attr,
    a.port_name,
    a.port_security_status,
    a.row_num
FROM down_ports d
JOIN admin_up_ports a ON d.mac_address = a.mac_address
